title: Legacy Versus Recency: How Should We Rank Gujarat Titans’s Greatest Performances?
dek: Ranking Gujarat Titans' greatest performances means weighing old classics against recent fireworks. Scoring has risen, so raw numbers favour the present.

sections.heading: Legacy and Recency
body: Every list of a franchise's greatest performances has to decide how to weigh old and new. Recent performances are vivid; older ones carry history.
By raw numbers, Gujarat Titans' highest individual innings is {{ev:lr-best}} and their best bowling figures are {{ev:lr-bowl}}.

sections.heading: The Raw Ranking
body: The chart lists Gujarat Titans' ten highest individual innings. {{ev:lr-top-recent}} of them came in 2024–2026, seasons that account for {{ev:lr-all-recent}} of all the franchise's innings.
Recent seasons are not over-represented in the top ten, despite the league-wide rise in scoring.

sections.heading: Bowling Runs the Other Way
body: With the ball, {{ev:lr-bowl-recent}} of the top ten spells by wickets came in 2024–2026, against {{ev:lr-allb-recent}} of all spells. Higher scoring makes great bowling figures harder to achieve.

sections.heading: A Fairer Ranking
body: A fairer ranking would express each performance relative to the scoring in its season, so that a century in a low-scoring year counts for more than one in a high-scoring year.
The venue-adjusted rating elsewhere in this series applies that idea to players.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Adjust Before You Rank
body: Raw rankings of Gujarat Titans' greatest innings do not lean heavily towards recent seasons.
Any definitive list should adjust for each season's scoring before comparing eras.
